items.title: Jon-Erik Kellso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 12, 1997
items.q: After moving to New York I started meeting guys like Dan Barrett, who introduced me to some of these other guys.

ctx.x: Yeah. You have to think about the context that you’re in. This particular album was more arranged than some of the — well here we go with words again — classic or whatever. Were these Rick Fay’s arrangements?

Rick Fay is the leader on this. It’s called “This is Where I Came In” right? Arbors Records? Dan Barrett was on there and I think that was Dan Barrett’s arrangement, which was taken largely from one of Bix Beiderbecke’s versions of that song. And he did a lot of arrangements on that album. I think Marty Grosz did do some arrangements on that © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-
album as well. A lot of those guys are here — Marty Grosz, Dan Barrett, Hal Smith is here.
